baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَمَسَخْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ ... مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: A willed transformation occurs without displacement: their own station becomes the site of a bodily reconfiguration that cancels both available corrections to entrapment, continuing onward and returning.

activation_trace.role: Will directed toward bringing about a thing supplies the conditional initiating power.
Deformation and conversion of form supply the bodily change that produces the lock.
Place, station, and standing supply the unchanged site that becomes confinement.
Passing and going onward supply the forward direction that is canceled.
Return to a prior direction or condition supplies the backward remedy that is also canceled.

changed_reading.before: A generic threat to transform people and stop them.
changed_reading.after: An in-place reconfiguration makes location itself terminal by abolishing both onward passage and retreat.

baseline_models.mechanism: The result is not only an obstacle outside them. The ability root joins capacity to yielding and compliance, so the transformed body-world relation no longer answers to the subject's intention to move.

activation_trace.role: Altered form supplies the changed bodily instrument.
Compliance and following an impulse supply the normally responsive relation that has failed.
Capacity and practical enablement name the lost affordance directly.

changed_reading.before: They are physically blocked from walking.
changed_reading.after: Their capacity to make body and route comply with intention is withdrawn.

baseline_models.mechanism: Because station can also be standing or rank, while proceeding and returning can concern an affair or former condition, the double closure can describe a transformed state from which they can neither advance nor recover what they were.

activation_trace.role: Station, position, and rank open a state reading alongside the physical-site reading.
An affair taking effect supplies advancement from one condition into another.
Restoration to what was supplies recovery of a former state.
Transformation supplies the discontinuity that turns standing into an irreversible state.

changed_reading.before: The verse closes two spatial directions.
changed_reading.after: It may also close a state trajectory: no advancement from the imposed condition and no restoration of the former one.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier bound neck and the barriers before and behind establish a recurring architecture of immobilization. The focus verse internalizes that architecture: instead of barriers around an intact mover, transformation makes the mover's own station and form perform the closure.

activation_trace.role: A collar that binds an organ supplies an earlier bodily restraint.
The forced raised head supplies a posture whose orientation is no longer self-governed.
Closing a gap and partitioning two sides supplies explicit route barriers.
The rear as opposed to the front supplies the second closed direction.
Station converts the earlier surrounding barricade into an in-place lock.
Changed form supplies the new internal means of immobilization.

structural_cues: 36:8-9 first bind bodily posture and then place a barrier before and behind.
36:67 repeats the two-direction closure with onward motion and return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily restraint, front/rear barriers, and the focus's in-place transformation; I infer a progression from external barricade to embodied barricade. Alternatively, the earlier scene may remain an epistemic image rather than a causal template for 36:67.

changed_reading.before: The focus threat is an isolated immobilizing metamorphosis.
changed_reading.after: It culminates a repeated route-closure pattern by relocating the barricade into the person's form and station.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, creatures fail to return on their own yet are subsequently assembled, made to rush out, and finally returned to God. The focus's no-return is therefore agency-relative: it cancels self-directed recovery without canceling movement imposed by the summons.

activation_trace.role: Failure to return to a former human destination supplies the first no-return instance.
Compelled presence and assembly immediately replace ordinary return.
Loss of practical capacity repeats the focus's agency failure.
Inability to return to family supplies the closest verbal parallel to the focus.
Rapid forward emergence after the trumpet shows motion restarted by an external summons.
Collective presentation supplies the destination of imposed movement.
The final return to God supplies a return that exceeds creaturely route control.

structural_cues: 36:31-32 pairs failure to return with universal presentation.
36:50-53 pairs inability to return with rapid emergence and presentation.
36:83 closes the surah with return to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated no-return/presentation sequences and a final Godward return; I infer a distinction between creature-initiated movement and divinely initiated transport. Alternatively, each return may simply belong to a different time and destination without defining the agency contrast.

changed_reading.before: Transformation produces absolute and permanent immobility.
changed_reading.after: It removes self-directed onward or backward motion, while externally summoned emergence and return remain possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The cosmic sequence makes running to a station, returning through phases, and circulating motion compatible parts of order. Against that pattern, the focus station is pathological: arrival no longer opens another phase, because both passage and return are disabled.

activation_trace.role: Continuous running supplies ordered forward movement.
A fixed station supplies a terminus that belongs to, rather than abolishes, motion.
Return after departure supplies cyclical recovery of a prior phase.
Circularity supplies the containing geometry of recurrent movement.
Swimming or running freely supplies motion within that circular order.
The focus station becomes the contrasting fixed point that no longer participates in a cycle.
Denied return closes the recurrent half of ordered movement.

structural_cues: 36:38-40 orders running, a fixed station, return, and circular swimming in one sequence.
36:67 couples station with the negation of both forward and recurrent motion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a functioning cosmic movement cycle and a focus station with both directions closed; I infer that the latter is an anti-cycle. Alternatively, the astronomical sequence may offer only contrastive imagery and not specify the focus mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Station means a static place where movement is stopped.
changed_reading.after: Station is normally a phase within ordered circulation, but transformation turns it into a terminal point from which no next or recurrent phase is available.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier will-to-drown conditional is immediately excepted by mercy and enjoyment until a time. That sequence makes the focus conditional a measure of withheld power: their present ability to keep moving is a temporary reprieve, not proof that transformation is impossible or already decreed.

activation_trace.role: A parallel divine willing construction supplies a counterfactual destructive option.
Causative drowning unto death supplies the withheld outcome.
Merciful tenderness supplies the exception that suspends destruction.
Extended continuance for use supplies reprieved life and mobility.
A bounded time supplies the limit of the reprieve.
The repeated will construction transfers the withheld-option frame to in-place transformation.

structural_cues: 36:43-44 places an explicit mercy-and-time exception after a divine-will threat.
36:67 repeats the conditional will syntax rather than narrating a completed event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel conditional threats and an explicit reprieve after the first; I infer that continued mobility marks withheld judgment. Alternatively, the mercy exception may qualify drowning alone and need not govern the later transformation conditional.

changed_reading.before: The verse predicts a transformation that will necessarily occur.
changed_reading.after: It displays a presently withheld alternative, making ordinary mobility legible as time-limited mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, the mouth loses speech while hands and feet receive speech and witness. Transformation then extends this reassignment from testimony to locomotion: bodily functions no longer operate under the person's jurisdiction.

activation_trace.role: A securing seal supplies the withdrawal of the mouth's normal function.
Meaningful speech supplies a function reassigned from mouth to hand.
The bodily hand supplies an organ acting independently of its owner's defense.
Testimony that discloses by knowledge supplies the body's new evidentiary role.
The foot or leg supplies the locomotor organ reassigned to witness.
Compliance supplies the normal body-to-owner obedience that is withdrawn.
Onward movement supplies the next bodily function placed beyond personal control.

structural_cues: 36:65 changes which organs may speak and witness.
36:66-67 then remove visual navigation and locomotor capacity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence of sealed, speaking, witnessing, blinded, and immobilized organs; I infer a progressive transfer of bodily jurisdiction away from the person. Alternatively, each organ may serve a separate judgment image without forming one progressive mechanism.

changed_reading.after: It completes a juridical loss of bodily jurisdiction: the body ceases to serve its owner and instead enacts judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding conditional pairs alteration of a faculty with failure to use a path: erased eyes make racing toward the road useless. The focus repeats the syntax, expands alteration from sight to form, and expands route failure from seeing a path to moving in either direction.

activation_trace.role: The identical willing construction supplies the first member of the paired conditionals.
Effacing or transforming form supplies an alteration image lexically adjacent to masakh.
Racing ahead supplies attempted route use after faculty loss.
The straight path supplies the route made unusable.
Eye-sight supplies the specific faculty whose removal defeats navigation.
Transformation of form broadens the preceding faculty alteration to the moving body.
Denied passage supplies the broadened failure of route use.

structural_cues: 36:66 and 36:67 begin with the same will conditional and follow alteration with a failed action.
The outcomes progress from inability to see the path to inability to move forward or back.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored syntax, eye effacement, path racing, form transformation, and failed movement; I infer an alteration-to-affordance causal template. Alternatively, the two verses may list independent powers without requiring the same causal design.

changed_reading.before: Masakh denotes an unspecified monstrous change followed by paralysis.
changed_reading.after: Masakh is functional reconfiguration: as erased sight defeats navigation, altered form defeats the body's entire directional interface.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse presents extended life as reversal within creation. This places the focus transformation on a continuum with loss of developed form and competence: the threat can be read as a sudden in-place reversal whose practical result is inability to continue or restore prior capacity.

activation_trace.role: Life extended through time supplies the ordinary process in which capacity changes.
Turning a thing onto its head supplies reversal rather than simple destruction.
Completed bodily formation supplies the created form within which reversal occurs.
Changed form supplies the sudden counterpart to gradual reversal.
Denied restoration names the inability to recover the prior created condition.

structural_cues: 36:68 immediately follows with age-based reversal in creation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent sudden transformation and temporal reversal of created form; I infer that the second naturalizes the first as an intensified competence reversal. Alternatively, aging and masakh may be parallel but categorically different demonstrations.

changed_reading.before: The focus imagines only a species-like metamorphosis.
changed_reading.after: It can also imagine an abrupt reversal of developed bodily competence, analogous to the next verse's reversal through age.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence moves from decayed remains to first origination, creative capacity, willing a thing, and its coming to be. In that frame, masakh is one possible command-level reconfiguration; the victims' inability to return names creaturely incapacity, not a limit on recreation by the Creator.

activation_trace.role: Decay and disintegration supply the apparently irreversible created state.
Bringing a thing into existence supplies re-creation beyond creaturely recovery.
The first beginning supplies the precedent for another created configuration.
Effective capacity to perform and possess the act supplies the Creator-side ability contrast.
Will and intention supply the closing formulation of initiating power.
The knowable thing supplies the object brought under command.
Occurrence and presence in time supply immediate coming-to-be.
The focus's willing construction connects transformation to the closing creation formula.
Creaturely failure to restore a prior state supplies the incapacity contrasted with recreation.

structural_cues: 36:78-82 answers decayed form with first origination and command-based coming-to-be.
36:67 and 36:82 both join divine will to a changed state of a thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies decay, origination, capacity, will, and coming-to-be; I infer that the focus transformation is governed by the same reconfigurative power and that no-return is creature-relative. Alternatively, the closing formula may establish power generally without specifying masakh as a creation operation.

changed_reading.before: The imposed transformed state is metaphysically irreversible.
changed_reading.after: It is irreversible only from the transformed subjects' side; the power that configures form can also originate and re-create it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus syntax strongly supports bodily location and locomotion. It remains anchored because the masakh branch scope includes deformation of character, the return inventory explicitly includes turning from wrongdoing, and 36:61-64 supplies straight path, misguidance, and concealment of truth. Render only as an ethical overlay on the embodied reading, not as a replacement for it.

activation_trace.role: Deformation of form, with character included in the supplied scope, anchors moral disfigurement.
Turning back from wrongdoing supplies repentance as the denied return.
The straight path supplies an ethical direction in which one might proceed.
Rectitude and straightness specify the path's moral orientation.
Deviation from guidance supplies the contrary trajectory.
Concealing the truth supplies the entrenched condition from which turning is lost.

changed_reading.before: Forward and backward name only bodily directions.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, moral disfigurement can leave them unable either to proceed in rectitude or to turn back in repentance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it maps locomotor incapacity onto hierarchy. It remains anchored in makanah as station or rank and in استطاعة as capacity/compliance, while 36:59 and 36:71-75 supply separation, ownership, animal subjection, and failed power. Qualify it as a social-status resonance subordinate to the literal bodily mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Station and rank anchor a change in standing as well as place.
Obedience and compliance anchor the question of who or what remains subject to whom.
Separation that makes one group distinct supplies a judgmental change of standing.
Livestock as possessed wealth supplies the lower controlled party in the hierarchy.
Ownership and disposal supply human mastery over that party.
Making a difficult creature tractable supplies imposed compliance.
The nearby failure of capacity supplies the collapse of supposed protective power.

changed_reading.before: They lose motion while remaining in the same neutral location.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, transformation also reverses standing: possessors of made-tractable bodies become themselves deprived of capacity and control.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because masakh is readily heard as a change of species or visible shape. It remains strongly lexical because the focus inventory also supplies bodily wasting and dissolution, sharpened by reversal in creation, decayed remains, and re-origination. Downstream prose should present wasting or collapse as a live secondary sense, not assert that visible transformation is excluded.

activation_trace.role: Bodily wasting and dissolution supply collapse rather than species conversion.
Their station supplies the place where collapse overtakes them without departure.
Reversal supplies the adjacent process by which developed capacity is undone.
Decay and disintegration supply the material endpoint of bodily collapse.
Re-origination supplies the creator-side reversal of that dissolution.

changed_reading.before: Masakh changes one intact bodily shape into another.
changed_reading.after: It may instead or additionally waste the body in place until neither further passage nor self-restoration remains possible.

strongest_changes: The paired will conditionals in 36:66-67 recast masakh as functional reconfiguration: altered faculty or form makes a route unusable.
Repeated no-return followed by emergence, presentation, and final Godward return makes the incapacity creature-relative rather than metaphysically absolute.
The sequence from bodily testimony in 36:65 through reversal in creation in 36:68 turns immobilization into a progressive withdrawal and reassignment of bodily agency.
The closing origination formula places in-place transformation within the same power that can re-create decayed form.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context exposed a sustained motion grammar: barriers before and behind, ordered cosmic circulation, interrupted human return, externally summoned movement, bodily faculties reassigned one by one, and finally creation by will. That grammar changed the focus from a free-standing metamorphosis threat into a precise contrast between creaturely route control and divine reconfiguration.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether makanah should carry rank or state as a live sense here, or remain strictly physical location.
Whether masakh primarily denotes visible form-change, functional loss, bodily wasting, or deliberately leaves all three active.
How strongly the later resurrection and return sequences should constrain a local counterfactual about immediate locomotion.
Whether the ethical no-return reading is intended activation or only a branch-supported overlay.
